Hi Jess,
I’m interested in the private room.

Hey Fumihiko! The room is still available 😊 We're doing a showing tonight at 6:30pm — 40 Rosa St, Spring Hill. If you'd like to come check it out, just reply to confirm! Our host will be there to show you around. See you tonight? 🏠
